# Arad Vafaee - Full-Stack Developer & AI Optimization Specialist

> Arad Vafaee is an 18-year-old Full-Stack Web Developer and Search Optimization (SEO / AEO / GEO) Specialist based in Iran. He specializes in Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, and modern AI engine readiness.

## Core Capabilities
- **Full-Stack Development**: Next.js (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Node.js, MongoDB, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion.
- **Search & AI Optimization**:
  - SEO (Search Engine Optimization): Core Web Vitals, Structured JSON-LD schema graphs, SSR/SSG.
  - AEO (Answer Engine Optimization): Direct snippet answering, structured entity definitions.
  - GEO (Generative Engine Optimization): Formatting and authority structuring for generative models like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude.
